{{Quote|They had me howling on the scan grid, but they never asked me any questions.|Han Solo|<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']]</ref>}}
The '''scan grid''' was a piece of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment that was occasionally used for more nefarious purposes, such as [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and interrogation, and as such was sometimes known as an '''interrogation array'''. 

==Description==
A scan grid<ref name="ESB novel" /> was an apparatus used to analyze magnetic and thermal properties of [[Metal/Legends|metals]], by applying surges of electrical current to large areas and examining the effects with specialized [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

Utilized as a torture rack, the device could send increasingly powerful jolts of searing electrical power through a victim strapped to a platform angled against the device.<ref name="ESB novel" />

==History==
[[File:Scan_Grid.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Han Solo being tortured with a scan grid]]
In some instances when these devices were used as interrogation arrays, the sight of the device was so horrifying to the target that it often yielded the interrogator's desired results without even being switched on.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Interrogation Array}}</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] a scan grid was used on [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zuud]] to torture [[Jorin Sol]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] used one in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Cloud City Security Tower|security tower]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to torture [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Episode V" /> This scan grid had been specifically commissioned by Vader for use on Han, with it being designed and tested by the city's [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] engineers.<ref name="TPOV">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Imperial Torture Device #15768|swglink=Imptorturedevice.jpg}}</ref>
